name: battery_long_span_alignment
prompt: The Today desk preview shows misaligned highlights when the model draft wins. Investigate why model spans disagree with deterministic spans in zackproser/ctx. Fix the span offsets so highlighting is byte-accurate against the normalized prompt. Add a regression test in the shadow harness. Deliver a reviewed pull request against main and do not merge it yourself. The task is complete once the merged CTX release passes independent deployment and authenticated desktop and phone browser verification.
paraphrases: Highlights in the Today desk preview are misaligned whenever the model draft is used. In zackproser/ctx, work out why the model's spans differ from the deterministic ones, correct the offsets so they are byte-accurate against the normalized prompt, and pin it with a shadow-harness regression test. Open a reviewed PR against main without merging it yourself; completion requires the merged CTX release to pass independent deployment and authenticated desktop and phone browser verification.
